allreduce_grads: allreduce gradients across GPUs for a list of model parameters with optional coalescing and bucket size
allreduce_coalesced: coalesce and allreduce a list of tensors by type or bucket size across distributed processes
reduce_mean: compute the mean of a tensor across all GPUs in a distributed training setup
distoptimizerhook_init: initialize a deprecated DistOptimizerHook for distributed training that delegates to mmcv.runner.OptimizerHook
review_dist_utils: review the dist_utils module for distributed training utility functions including gradient allreduce and tensor reduction
